explication: Agent Skills is a portable library of Markdown playbooks that designers and builders load into coding agents. The main workflow is to choose a skill for a task, follow its steps and linked references, and produce prompts, captured references, or implementation guidance for building interfaces and games. The README highlights a reference-to-prompt workflow as well as separate 3D, game-development, UI, and media capabilities. Most skills are represented by their documented directory paths; sampled source only supports details for the specific helper scripts and scroll conductor shown.
